subject: CPPO coordination for Acme / CloudForge resell
messages:
From: Alice Nguyen <alice@cloudforge.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Intro + CPPO sync for Acme Corp opportunity

Hi Karthik —

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. We (CloudForge Partners) are lined up to resell Redwood to Acme Corp; Acme has asked for an AWS Channel Private Offer (CPPO) to be created so they can apply their commit. Can you help coordinate the flow?

Quick context: Acme expects a 12-month term, estimated annual spend ~$420k, wants a 15% channel discount off list, and needs the offer in their AWS account before 03/05 so procurement can approve. Tom Ellis (Acme procurement) is on this thread.

What we need from Redwood to get this over the line:
- Confirm list price and the discount you can approve for CPPO (or whether this needs revenue approval)
- Provide the CPPO-ready PO template / legal contact for markups
- Point person who will create the private offer in the AWS Marketplace console (or confirm if CloudForge should submit the request via your CPPO rep)

Attached: cloudforge-pricing-proposal.docx (high-level numbers from reseller).

Happy to hop on a 30-min sync today if that helps.

Thanks,
Alice Nguyen
Head of Partnerships | CloudForge Partners
mobile: +1 415-555-0199
[Attachment: cloudforge-pricing-proposal.docx]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice@cloudforge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Intro + CPPO sync for Acme Corp opportunity

Hi Alice —

Appreciate the context. Happy to coordinate. Proposed immediate next steps:

1) Ben (sales ops) to share the Redwood CPPO template and confirm approval path for a 15% channel discount.
2) CloudForge to confirm final list of SKUs + quantities (so we can generate exact list price).
3) I will loop in our AWS CPPO contact if we need Redwood to open the private-offer request; otherwise we can authorize the reseller to raise it on our behalf with a PO/contract attached.

I can join a 30-min call today at 2pm PT; if that works for Tom / Ben, please confirm and I’ll send a calendar invite.

For planning: does Acme require any unusual compliance artifacts (SaaS data residency / SOC2 evidence) to attach to the CPPO? If yes, Ben / Marissa can pull those.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Channel & Partnerships
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 650-555-0102

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice@cloudforge.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 08:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Redwood CPPO template + next steps

Karthik / Alice —

See attached the CPPO PO template and a short checklist for CPPO submission. Notes:
- 15% channel discount requires Director approval for SKU-level discounts >12% (I've already put the request in and expect sign-off today).
- We need exact SKU codes + quantities to populate the private-offer payload (AWS rejects incomplete SKU lists).
- If CloudForge will submit the private-offer through our AWS Channel rep, please include our partner alias (Redwood-Channel-001) in the request.

Attachments: redwood-cppo-template.pdf (CPPO PO + fillable PDF), redwood-cppo-checklist.xlsx (internal).

I can create a draft private-offer in AWS once approvals return; alternatively Alice, if you prefer to submit and tag Redwood as the publisher contact, let me know and I’ll fast-track approvals.

Ben Carter
Senior Account Manager, Partnerships
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-cppo-template.pdf]

From: Alice Nguyen <alice@cloudforge.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@acme.com>, AWS CPPO Rep <cppo-aws@amazon.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 15:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: CPPO coordination for Acme / CloudForge resell

Thanks Ben — and thanks everyone for moving quickly. Quick updates from our side:

- Acme confirmed the SKU list and quantities this morning; total list price before discounts is $494,000 for a 12-month term.
- Procurement (Tom) confirmed they need the private offer created in their AWS account under acct id 1234-5678-9012 and they require a signed PO attached.
- AWS CPPO rep (cc'd) is available to assist in creating the offer but requested that Redwood be the publisher contact for the listing.

Given that Ben mentioned a Director approval for >12% discounts, CloudForge is prepared to accept a 12% approved channel discount now and sign immediately; we can re-engage on a commercial uplift if Redwood grants the 15% later. Can you confirm Director sign-off ETA? If we get a 12% CPPO created today, procurement can approve and we can push for a 15% amendment next quarter.

Attaching the signed PO draft here for your intake: final_acme_po_signed.pdf (placeholder, CloudForge will circulate signed counterpart once CPPO created).

Next steps requested:
- Ben / Karthik: confirm whether Redwood will act as publisher contact in the AWS CPPO flow.
- AWS CPPO rep: please advise whether you need any additional publisher metadata or legal contact to proceed.

Thanks,
Alice Nguyen
Head of Partnerships | CloudForge Partners
[Attachment: final_acme_po_signed.pdf]
